annotation.summary_en: A bank robbery is interrupted by a domestic dispute when a man realizes his own mother-in-law is the customer he is attempting to rob.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins in a bank lobby where a man in a denim jacket is arguing with an older woman wearing a pearl necklace about withdrawing money for an apartment. The man complains that the current funds only cover a one-bedroom flat, while the woman retorts that she doesn't care about his living conditions as long as her daughter and grandchild can live with her. The tension peaks when a robber wearing a beanie and gloves bursts in, brandishing a gun. He forces everyone to lie down, calls the teller 'beauty,' and demands all the cash. He then orders a bank employee named Avetisyan to bring the security camera recordings. However, the robbery takes a surreal turn when the robber recognizes the customers. The ending reveals a familial connection, as the man in the denim jacket identifies the woman as his mother-in-law ('zoqanch'). The chaotic scene involves a physical struggle with the security guard and a chase through the bank offices as the robber tries to manage his professional crime and his personal family baggage simultaneously.
